---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
data <- fromJSON("data/data.json")
```

```{r}

moratorium <- data |> select(name, party, moratorium) |> 
  count(moratorium, party) |> 
  arrange(desc(moratorium))

water <- data |> select(name, party, water) |> 
  count(water, party) |> 
  arrange(desc(water)) 

power <- data |> select(name, party, power) |> 
  count(power, party) |> 
  arrange(desc(power)) 

zoning <- data |> select(name, party, zoning) |> 
  count(zoning, party) |> 
  arrange(desc(zoning)) 

tax_breaks <- data |> select(name, party, tax_breaks) |> 
  count(tax_breaks, party) |> 
  arrange(desc(tax_breaks)) 

```


Extra analysis: 
```{r}
# Moratoriums

# What did New York candidates say on moratoriums?

data |> filter(state == "New York") |> 
  select(state, name, party, moratorium)


# What did candidates in states with introduced moratoriums say? (states where moratoriums have been introduced and not vetoed or failed, as of Sept. 15, https://www.ncsl.org/fiscal/which-states-are-banning-data-centers)

data |> filter(state %in% c("Delaware", "Georgia", "Michigan", 
                            "New Jersey", "Pennsylvania", 
                            "South Carolina", "Vermont", "Virginia")) |> 
  select(state, name, party, moratorium)


# Power

# Who said no on the power issue?

data |> filter(power == "No") |> 
  select(state, name, party, power)


# Zoning

# Who did not support noise assessments?

data |> filter(zoning == "No") |> 
  select(state, name, party, zoning)


# Tax incentives

# Who supported tax incentives for data centers?

data |> filter(tax_breaks == "Yes")

# What about states that do not currently offer tax incentives? (according to NCSL, https://www.ncsl.org/fiscal/subsidizing-servers-how-states-are-competing-to-attract-data-centers)

data |> filter(tax_breaks == "Yes") |> 
  filter(state %in% c("Colorado", "New Mexico", "Oregon", 
                      "California", "Alaska", "Hawaii", 
                      "Nebraska", "South Dakota", "Rhode Island", 
                      "Vermont", "New Hampshire", "Maine"))


```
